title: Test that a failed Kimi read-only answer handoff publishes no refusal notice
outcome: Test that a failed Kimi read-only answer handoff publishes no refusal notice
acceptance: A behavioral test drops the runtime answer receiver, submits a refused read-only operation, observes the returned error and verifies the transcript is unchanged with no MessageCreated delta.
The test protects answer-handoff-before-notice ordering without mirroring production reason strings, and preserves existing stale/Stop/refusal behavior coverage.
